question: Will Volodymyr Zelenskyy attend the Special European Council in Brussels in person on 26–27 November 2026?

calls.reasoning: Prior: from memory, Zelenskyy attended in person roughly half of 2024-26 European Council meetings and joined the rest by video (not counted against sources). He attended in person in Dec 2025, Jun 2026 and Oct 2026. For: Ukraine's 2027 financing is the main item, with Costa and von der Leyen confirming on 12 Nov that it will be discussed. Against: heavy travel (Dublin EPC 12 Nov, Berlin Coalition of the Willing 19 Nov), intense peace diplomacy, a cancelled late-October Brussels trip, and only remote participation in the 4 Nov Brussels meeting. The summit is also partly about the EU budget (MFF). No invitation or announcement found. No human prediction market found on Polymarket, Kalshi, Manifold or bookmakers.
calls.dossier:
- Special European Council: 26-27 Nov 2026, Europa building, Brussels. EU-Western Balkans summit on 25 Nov, Euro Summit on 26 Nov. Accreditation advisory published 23 Oct 2026 (consilium.europa.eu).
- Costa, press conference after the informal Dublin meeting on 13 Nov 2026: 'at our next European Council on 26 and 27 November, we will discuss Ukraine's financing needs for next year and beyond.' No mention of a Zelenskyy invitation (Interfax-Ukraine, 13 Nov).
- Joint Costa/von der Leyen statement after meeting Zelenskyy at the EPC in Dublin, 12 Nov: 26-27 Nov EUCO will discuss Ukraine's urgent 2027 financing based on the Commission proposal.
- Kyiv faces at least a EUR70bn shortfall in 2027, with the EU expected to cover about EUR45bn. Dublin informal summit (13 Nov) left this and the choice of an EU peace envoy unresolved (Irish Times, 14 Nov).
- Zelenskyy's travel this month: EPC Dublin 12 Nov (in person). Ramstein group in Brussels 17 Nov (defence ministers). Coalition of the Willing in Berlin 19 Nov, invited by Merz with more than 20 heads of state expected (Interfax 1230578; RFE/RL 15 Nov).
- 4 Nov 2026: Ukraine/US/EU/NATO team-level meetings in Brussels. A search summary says Zelenskyy joined an EU enlargement event that day remotely (Ukrinform 4180995; not independently verified).
- A planned Zelenskyy Brussels trip in the week of 26 Oct for talks with US/EU/NATO was cancelled at short notice after the US changed plans (Euronews, 26 Oct).
- Recent in-person EUCO attendance: 18-19 Dec 2025, 18-19 Jun 2026, 15-16 Oct 2026 (day 2 only, joint doorstep with Costa and von der Leyen). Past precedent: he attended the 6 Mar 2025 special EUCO on Ukraine and defence in person after an explicit invitation letter from Costa (Yahoo/news, Mar 2025). Other EUCOs in 2024-25 he joined by video.
- Rough base rate over 2024-26 EUCOs with Ukraine on the agenda: in person about half the time, otherwise video. This is approximate, from background recall, and not counted against sources. Conditional on Ukraine financing being the central decision item: in-person attendance looks more common (Dec 2025 loan decision: in person).
- Diplomacy: US-Ukraine-Russia talks in Abu Dhabi 10-11 Nov. Witkoff and Kushner shuttling. A European negotiating team is forming. Peace-talk events could clash with the dates.
- Status quo: nothing announced about whether he will attend. Absent an invitation or announcement, the default format for non-member leaders is no presence or video.
- Resolves off Council newsroom photos/videos/press releases or credible reporting of physical presence in Brussels at the summit on 26 or 27 Nov (Brussels time). Video or pre-recorded address = NO. Postponement or all-virtual = annulled.
- Event window: 26 Nov 2026 -> 27 Nov 2026 per the criteria. As of 16 Nov 0% has elapsed (the event is 10 days away).
- Searched but not found: a formal invitation letter for 26-27 Nov, any Kyiv announcement of his schedule for 26-27 Nov, the Council's annotated draft agenda (the 4 Nov agenda PDF returned 403), and any Polymarket/Kalshi/Manifold/bookmaker market on this event.

calls.reasoning: Reference class: Zelenskyy's attendance at European Councils with Ukraine on the agenda, 2025-26. He was in person at Mar 2025 (special), Oct 2025, Dec 2025, Jun 2026 and Oct 2026, and on video at Mar 2025 (regular) and Mar 2026, so roughly 65-70% in person. This special summit centres on Ukraine's 2027 financing, which is a strong reason to come. Against that: nothing has been announced 10 days out (normal, since his trips are announced late for security). The late-October Brussels trip was cancelled at short notice. US-Russia-Ukraine diplomacy could clash with the dates. He is travelling heavily (Dublin 12-13 Nov, Berlin 19 Nov). Part of the agenda is internal MFF haggling, and a video address is an easy fallback. No market found.
calls.reconciliation: The runs disagreed on three points. (1) The base rate: Run 1 recalled about 50% in person, while Runs 2 and 3 counted about 3/3 recent regular meetings or 60-75%. Run 3's enumeration is the most complete and supports about 65-70%, and Run 1 admitted its figure was uncounted recall. (2) Whether his remote appearance at the 4 Nov 'enlargement summit' counts against him. My search shows it was Euronews' media conference of that name, not an EU leaders' summit, so it is weak evidence. (3) Whether he has been invited or has announced plans. Searches for an invitation or announcement for 26-27 Nov found only the March 2025 invitation letter and nothing for this meeting, so the status is unknown, which is normal this far out. What remains is judgment: whether a special summit on Ukraine financing pulls him in, set against diplomatic and travel risk and the internal-budget part of the agenda. I land at 0.60, a bit below the two higher runs, because nothing is confirmed, the October trip was cancelled, and a December EUCO likely gives him another chance to appear.
